definitions.explanation: Doing something swiftly without wasting time. Often implies impatience.

examples.japanese: さっさと⟦{帰|かえ}ろう→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
さっさと⟦{片付|かたづ}けなさい→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さっさと⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}わらせた→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。

notes:
さっさと expresses doing something quickly without wasting time, often with a nuance of impatience.

USAGE:
Typically used when urging someone to hurry up or describing efficient action. Can sound pushy or impatient in commands.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- さっさと⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to clean up quickly
- さっさと⟦{済|す}ませる→済ます：02064_sumasu⟧: to finish up quickly
- さっさと⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧: to hurry home
- さっさと⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go quickly

REGISTER:
Informal. Using さっさと in commands (さっさとし⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧) sounds demanding or frustrated.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{素早|すばや}く→素早い：17093_subayai⟧: quickly, swiftly (neutral)
- ⟦てきぱき→てきぱき：05649_tekipaki⟧: briskly, efficiently (positive)
- ⟦ぐずぐず→ぐずぐず：05844_guzuguzu⟧: slowly, dawdling (negative, opposite meaning)
